en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, rectangular three‑storey school building on a street corner. The structure has a tiled hip roof with dormers, many tall rectangular windows, and a stone base. There are two arched entrances with short stairways; one bears a relief sculpture and inscription above the arch. Hungarian text is printed along the top border of the image, and more Hungarian inscriptions appear on the facade, including a coat‑of‑arms panel. A few pedestrians walk along the street in front.
